Class WildyAgilityLootTrackerPlugin

  • java.lang.Object
    • net.runelite.client.plugins.Plugin
      • com.lita.WildyAgilityLootTrackerPlugin
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    com.google.inject.Module
    @PluginDescriptor(name="WildyAgilityLootTracker")
public class WildyAgilityLootTrackerPlugin
extends net.runelite.client.plugins.Plugin
    Plugin Main Class - handle and trigger events in accordance with plugin lifecycle, execute main business logic, Tie everything together.

    Lifecycle (as I understand it)

          startUp()
          _init()
              ...
              ClientThread.invoke(Runnable)
                  init_LootItems()
